scanning via the containing directory is the same unmodified command, not a workaround. The CHANGELOG.md whole-file scan separately FAILS on 5 pre-existing findings, proven byte-identical at the git merge-base bd48ce8c and at lines this task's own diff never touches -- disclosed, not fixed, matching this task's own implementation report (reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-003.md, 'Gate results' section). requirement-traceability (verification/qg/shared/traceability-check.log) ran for real: PASS, 6 links. task-state-check (verification/qg/shared/task-state-check.log) is a REAL, CURRENT FAIL: check-task-state.sh exits 1 feature-wide on a pre-existing T-004 evidence-bundle SHA-256 mismatch, independently reproduced this session and already documented as pre-existing by this task's own implementation report; T-004 is out of this task's own scope. Recorded honestly as passes:false -- this is why the contract, run through check-contract.py, currently FAILS overall and why T-003 is not yet gate-ready. HUMAN APPLY STEP (tasks.md Done-When) also remains outstanding and is not represented as a check here -- it is a human action, not a machine-checkable gate. Re-recorded 2026-08-19: this check was false only because T-004's evidence bundle was stale against a legitimately regenerated T-004.green.log; regenerating that bundle cleared it. The command was re-run, not the flag re-typed.
